The '''Assault Gunboat combat medallion''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] medal awarded for completing basic training with [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wings]]. It had an engraving of an Imperial ''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wing.

There were three versions of the medal, which differed only in the metal used to create it: [[Bronze/Legends|bronze]], [[Silver/Legends|silver]], and [[Gold/Legends|gold]]. The bronze version was awarded to pilots who completed training relating to the Star Wing's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] projectors as well as using its capabilities in conjunction with a starfighter screen to accomplish a mission's objectives. The silver version was awarded to pilots who completed training relating to the above as well as a reenactment of a search-and-destroy against a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] frigate and an onslaught of Rebel forces. The gold version was presented to pilots who completed the above training operations as well as a reenactment of an escort mission involving the group ''[[Rugle]]''.

==Known recipients==
[[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] received all three versions of this medal after completing the training ops relating to the Star Wing shortly after it and the [[TIE/ad starfighter]] line [[Arms Race|entered mass production]].
